图个好游戏：在PC上提前体验“GTA6”？这游戏55万人在线，还干进全球Top3！

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/MKVWkabntevjliF.gif!a-3-854x.gif
又到了我们看图挑游戏的日子，小弟只给大家推荐那些够炸裂、够吸睛、够有视觉冲击力的好游戏！每周锁定这里，让你大饱眼福！
今天要给大家介绍的是《ROB RUN》。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/KPUTVFbuidcnlBv.png!a-3-854x.png
大家期待已久的《GTA6》终于是来了，不过如果你没有PlayStation 5 或者 Xbox 的话，就只能眼馋别人看一看了。
不过或许，前不久《ROB RUN》这款“蹭”GTA6的游戏，可以让你在PC上体验一下《GTA6》的都市犯罪氛围。
这款游戏在11月初登陆Steam开启抢先体验之后，热度就像坐了火箭一样一路狂飙。
开服首日在线人数还只有2万出头，结果短短两周内，它的最高同时在线人数居然直接冲到了接近55万，挤进了Steam在线前三，畅销榜也杀到了第七，累计下载量更是突破了360万。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/EFytskbuidcnkFw.png!a-3-854x.png
可在如此炸裂的热度背后，它的口碑却上演了一出极致的两极分化。在Steam超过五万条玩家评价里，整体好评率只有可怜的50%左右，简体中文区好评率更是只有24%。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/WKBoevbuidcnkim.png!a-3-854x.png
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/rBOEMYbuidcnjrC.png!a-3-854x.png
而这款游戏的开发商Kefir也颇有来头，工作室早在2009年就开张，不过更为让国内玩家熟知的是那句《地球末日：生存》那句“开局一人一狗，装备全靠捡”。
当时这支仅仅15人的小团队，只用了62天就把游戏赶了出来，结果上线三个月就在Google Play拿下了破千万的下载，如今累计下载量早已破亿，哪怕运营了近十年，每个月依旧收入超50万美元。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/mURlWKbuidcnixk.png!a-3-854x.png
这次的《ROB RUN》，正是Kefir跳出手游舒适区后，在PC端游领域交出的第一份正式答卷。
那么，《ROB RUN》到底怎么样？为什么能让几十万人顶着差评也要往里冲？一起来看看吧。
要点一：真人同城，把GTA塞进搜打撤
乍一看《ROB RUN》的宣传画面，不少人可能会觉得它就是个低配版的《GTA Online》，满大街跑车追逐、警匪交火、银行抢劫，都市犯罪的味儿确实挺足的，但它跟传统的开放世界完全不是一回事。
官方给它的定位其实是“撤离射击类游戏”，说得更直白点，它像是把《GTA》的都市犯罪外衣，套进了当下最火的“搜打撤”框架里，再揉进了一点《Rust》的生存建造，搞出了一场大型真人版的“猫鼠游戏”。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/pXzFbLbuidcniac.png!a-3-854x.png
游戏的故事发生在一座名叫“洛蒂湾”（Looty Bay）的沿海城市，由一座跨海大桥连着三座小岛构成。整座城市里几乎没有几个功能性NPC，除了商店里站柜台的店员和接任务的向导，马路上开车的司机、街角巡逻的警察、巷子里鬼鬼祟祟的混混，全都是屏幕另一端的真实玩家。
游戏没有任何预设的剧情任务，也没有按部就班的脚本，整座城市是秩序井然还是彻底乱套，全看这五千号人上演。
玩家刚进游戏时，只是一个刚从监狱放出来的穷光蛋，身无分文，只能暂时借住在安全区“莱尼汽车旅馆”里。想要搞到第一桶金，你就得进入洛蒂湾讨生活。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/MgYMUQbuidcngFo.png!a-3-854x.png
刚进城时，所有人默认都是“平民”身份，这时候你可以安安心心地在城里闲逛踩点，去武器店、珠宝店摸摸底，或者翻翻路边的垃圾桶碰碰运气。只要你不主动惹事，就算被人击倒了，身上的东西也不会掉落。
但老老实实捡破烂哪有来钱快的路子刺激？只要你心一横，接下来，便利店、珠宝店甚至银行金库都是你的提款机。
你可以先绕到店后拆掉警报控制器、打碎监控摄像头来个悄无声息的潜入，也可以直接端着枪冲进去逼住店员暴力洗劫。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/Uxllofbuidcngew.png!a-3-854x.png
可在这个游戏里，“抢”只是第一步，不能带走一切白干。
只要店员按下报警键，全城的玩家警察都会收到警情提示。而且《ROB RUN》里的赃物不能直接卖给普通商店，必须送到地图上公开标记的固定销赃点才能换成黑钱，或者驾车冲过跨海大桥的两端撤离点逃出生天。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/FgfOxBbuidcnfcc.png!a-3-854x.png
如果你不想当提心吊胆的劫匪，也可以去警局报名当一名“警察”。
当警察的好处是不用自己花钱买装备，警局直接配发制式武器和巡逻车，执勤期间就算阵亡了，也只是复活时间变长，随身私人物品不会丢失。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/ysPyRvbuidcndvC.png!a-3-854x.png
警察的日常就是开着警灯满大街巡逻，盯着地图上的报警提示去抓捕罪犯。击倒罪犯后，你可以选择直接击毙没收赃物，也可以戴上手铐活捉归案，活捉不仅能拿到更高的警察值，还能在结束执勤或者联邦调查局抵达倒计时结束时，把积攒的警察值和没收的赃物按比例折算成丰厚的工资。随着警衔往上升，还能解锁更高级的警用装备。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/vtuRRJbuidcnbyh.png!a-3-854x.png
更有意思的是，游戏里甚至允许被捕的罪犯向警察行贿，只要价码谈得拢，警察当场放人也不是不可能，有时候可以帮你挽回远高于这笔贿赂的损失。
就算你侥幸带着钱逃出了洛蒂湾，回到了自己的安全屋，这场博弈也远没有结束。刚销赃拿到的现金全都是黑钱，必须放进基地的设备里走一遍洗钱流程，洗白之后存进银行卡，这笔钱才算真正落袋为安。
而你的藏身基地本身也不是绝对安全的保险箱，其他玩家随时可以组队来抄你的家。
你得像玩《Rust》一样规划墙体、布置陷阱、安装保险丝来拖延入侵者的时间，一旦防御被攻破，辛苦攒下的物资和现金照样会被洗劫一空。
随着手里的钱越来越多，玩家还能沿着官方设计的“金字塔”阶级往上爬。
你可以解锁科技树，购置更快的跑车甚至武装直升机，也能在有限的地皮上买地盖房、建造地下农场，甚至当起包租公把地块租给其他玩家收租金，再往上还能拉起自己的犯罪氏族，抢占城市里的核心产业和领地，一路混成整个地区的总督。
不过游戏有个非常激进的设定——每七天一次的“联邦清剿”。
每隔一周，服务器就会强制全服清档一次。不管你之前有多少豪车、多少地皮、多少存款，清档时间一到，所有人都会被重新关进监狱，一切推倒重来。唯一能留下的，只有系统根据你这一周攒下的资产和罪行折算出的“刑期声望”以及永久纹身外观。
在选服的监狱大厅里，扫一眼谁身上的纹身多，就知道谁是叱咤风云的狠角色。
要点二：一半人喊真香，一半人骂劝退
正是这样一套把高风险、强社交和快节奏轮回糅合到一起的机制，让《ROB RUN》在玩家群体里炸出了截然不同的两种声音，喜欢的人捧上天，讨厌的人恨不得连夜退款卸载。
先说那些给出好评的玩家。
很多玩家喜欢这款游戏，喜欢的其实是真人驱动的“活人味”和戏剧性。
在如今很多网游任务高度流水线化的背景下，《ROB RUN》里每一分钟发生的事情都是不可预测的。你可能前脚刚和路边认识的野人兄弟联手端掉一家珠宝店，后脚在分赃的时候就被对方一枪放倒独吞了所有战利品；也可能在被一群警察追得上天无路时，靠着三寸不烂之舌花钱买通了带队的警长成功脱身。
对于喜欢拉上三五好友开黑的团队玩家来说，既有搜打撤的紧张刺激，又不用像传统MMO那样被无尽的日常任务绑架，每周都是全新的大型生存剧本杀。
再加上游戏本体完全免费，付费点也老老实实地克制在外观皮肤、基地装饰和赛季通行证上，没有搞那些破坏平衡的数值氪金，而且整个客户端安装包只有4.7G，下载试错成本极低，确实让不少人玩得上头。
但是游戏的差评区也暴露出了游戏目前存在着大量的问题。
首当其冲的就是对独狼玩家和新手极其不友好的生存环境。
游戏里常规小队上限虽然限制在三人，但同语言、同帮派的玩家很容易在城里抱团形成默契。一个刚进服的新人，手里只有一把破手枪和一辆慢吞吞的免费破车，出门抢劫一触发警报就会被全图标记，在路上既要躲着全副武装的警察追捕，又要防着开着跑车的老油条劫匪黑吃黑，往往忙活半天连销赃点的门都摸不到就被送回了老家。
哪怕去当警察，新手警员面对成群结队、装备精良的犯罪帮派也是毫无还手之力，更别提有时候警局职位爆满，想当警察还得排队等空缺。
多重压力叠加下来，想要在《ROB RUN》玩得舒服，稳定的在线时长和靠谱的固定队友基本成了刚需。
其次，强制七天一清档的设定也是一把双刃剑。
硬核玩家觉得节奏快、不固化，可对于每天只有一两个小时空闲时间的休闲玩家来说，好不容易攒出点家底，刚买上心仪的装备和房子，还没捂热乎就要说拜拜了，这种辛苦付诸东流的无力感实在是太折磨人了。

content.v: 韩国游戏展G-STAR 2026于昨日（22日）闭幕，为期四天的展会共吸引约20.1万名观众到场。
本届G-STAR由韩国游戏产业协会主办，G-STAR组委会与釜山信息产业振兴院共同承办，11月19日至22日在釜山BEXCO举办。共有来自42个国家和地区的1294家企业参展。
组委会介绍，本次展会采用全预约制，扩充了第二展馆内容，时隔三年重启礼堂电竞赛场，同时扩容Coser休息区，让观展人流分散至整个展馆。今年口号为“Expand your Horizons”（开拓你的视界），聚焦跨产业融合、联动线上平台以及自有内容升级。
对比去年，参展企业与展位数量有所增加，观众规模基本持平。G-STAR 2025有来自44国家和地区的1273家企业参展，展位3269个，到访观众约20.2万人。今年参展国家和地区数量减少2个，但参展企业增加21家、展位增加176个，观众统计约20.1万人。
BTB商务馆付费买家、独立游戏展区数据呈现不同变化：BTB馆付费买家从去年2190人降至今年1894人，减少296人。G-STAR独立游戏展示会，由去年20国80家企业、400个展位，变更为今年28国108家企业、250个展位；参展国家增加8个、开发厂商增加28家，展位缩减150个。
第一展馆BTC馆内，6家海内外企业布置了百个展位以上的大型展台。主赞助商AI故事创作平台Kraken搭建体验区，并举办乐队QWER小型演唱会；连续十年参展的Krafton展出《绝地求生》、新作《Tarra: Unbound》、《Age Twister》、《磕磕绊绊圆舞曲》、《装备勇者》。

content.v: 基于Arch Linux的CachyOS现已推出261122版本，为Epic Games新版Easy Anti-Cheat Linux v2准备运行基础设施。新版本提供可选专用内核，同时加入系统恢复镜像及重新设计的软件包安装器。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261123/1795401029_385354_jpg_r.jpg
新版反作弊要求系统满足八项安全条件，其中包括TPM 2.0、IOMMU、Secure Boot、禁用kexec、启用BPF LSM，以及将内核锁定为仅加载签名模块。为减少这些限制对日常使用的影响，开发团队准备了linux-cachyos-eac专用内核、签名的systemd-boot引导程序，以及自动配置和检查启动链的eac-setup、eac-status工具。
专用内核会在启动菜单中设置独立入口，原有普通启动方案继续保留，用户可在运行支持新版反作弊的游戏时切换。由于DKMS模块与该内核不兼容，nvidia-open、nvidia-580xx、ZFS和r8125驱动均提供单独的预签名软件包。
系统端完成适配并不代表受保护游戏一定能够运行，最终仍取决于Epic Games是否将该发行版签名加入受信任密钥列表。SteamOS目前也因硬件和软件条件不足而不受支持。
261122版本还加入约70MB的cachyos-recovery恢复镜像，支持查看、测试及回滚Btrfs快照。CachyOS Package Installer 2.0.0也已重新制作，新增AUR脚本审查、静态分析以及Flatpak和AppImage支持。

content.v: 《GTA6》主角杰森沉默寡言、反应克制，并非角色塑造不足，而是制作团队有意进行的一次尝试。Rockstar Games叙事高级副总裁Rupert Humphries表示，团队希望探索电子游戏人物能否减少台词，更多依靠气场、表情和动作传递信息。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261123/1795399111_837566_jpg_r.jpg
杰森此前曾因语调单一受到批评。Humphries解释称，演员史蒂夫·麦奎因在1972年犯罪惊悚片《亡命大煞星》中的表演，是该角色的参考之一。开发者还研究了退伍军人，尤其是陆军游骑兵克制说话和回应的方式，这也与杰森已经确立的军旅背景相符。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261123/1795399119_796725_jpg_r.jpg
游戏中，杰森常通过表情、手势、哼声和低语与露西亚沟通，较为健谈的露西亚也会采用类似方式。这些非语言互动体现了两人的熟悉与默契，同时让露西亚的强势与杰森的内敛形成互补。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261123/1795399123_236207_jpg_r.jpg

content.v: 《 以撒的结合：重生 》免费在线DLC“忏悔+”因加入未披露的AI生成音乐遭遇大量差评，Steam近期好评率降至8%。引发争议的音乐目前已从游戏中撤下。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261123/1795398322_352899_jpg_r.jpg

争议随后转向挑战使用的音乐。玩家认为其音色带有Suno生成音乐常见的失真感，并在音乐文件注释中发现Suno元数据，但该DLC的Steam页面并未披露AI内容。受此影响，“忏悔+”近期评价降至“差评如潮”，部分玩家将责任归于获得《以撒的结合》授权的发行商Nicalis。
原作者埃德蒙·麦克米伦表示，他事前并不知道每日挑战采用了生成音乐，正在调查这段音乐出现的原因并推动移除。相关配乐现已撤下，此次争议同时涉及商店页面的AI内容披露、授权作品的制作管理，以及开发参与者能否充分知晓新增素材。

content.v: 距HBO的《哈利·波特》剧集首播还有五周，华纳兄弟探索被曝已对粉丝YouTube频道发起版权投诉。据Cosmic Book News报道，投诉带来的后果包括视频被删除、部分频道被封禁，以及创作者被取消变现资格。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/23/cas_auto/small_0_9481620.jpg
报道称，最先受到波及的是制作恶搞AI视频的Malfoid频道，其内容把德拉科·马尔福塑造成女性形象。仅两条被删除的视频，合计播放量就达到700万。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/23/small_202611230945379020.png
拥有近200万订阅的MovieFlame同样被卷入，其作者摩根·罗斯对一条介绍剧集首个公布场景的视频被取消变现表示不满，并强调自己长期在推广这个项目。
另一位频道作者Valliant Renegade则表示，拒绝评测这部即将上线的剧集。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/23/small_202611230945457453.png
对熟悉《哈利·波特》IP的观众来说，这次争议的看点在于官方与粉丝内容的关系。粉丝频道多年积累的解说、二创和恶搞视频，客观上为剧集维持了讨论热度；而在首播前收紧版权，直接影响到这些创作者的收益和更新意愿。
报道还援引该媒体内部人士的说法，称HBO内部对项目前景的担忧正在加剧，剧集预算据称达到5亿美元（约合人民币33.39亿元），第一季单集制作成本约2520万美元（约合人民币1.68亿元）。
Cosmic Book News同时表示，此前在报道《绿灯侠》剧集时也遭遇过华纳兄弟探索的类似动作，并怀疑对方试图限制负面报道。

《A Wasteland Full of Cats》由巴西工作室 Devcats 负责制作，并联动非营利动物救援机构共同推出。贝塞斯达发言人在声明中表示，支持动物救援是团队和玩家社区多年来一直关心的事情，包括工作室自2015年起与Dallas Pets Alive建立的长期合作。双方的共同理念与 Devcats 独特的创作方式相结合，让《辐射》世界观以更有意义的方式呈现出来。

items.title: 以撒的结合 DLC 在 GTA 6 恶搞更新中添加了 AI 音乐，尽管没有 AI 披露，Steam 评论降至压倒性负面，音乐被下架
items.summary: "Woke up to a shit show," Edmund McMillen wrote.

content.v: While most videogames got out of the way of Grand Theft Auto 6, on the day of its release The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth's free online DLC Repentance+ released an update. It included an easter egg daily challenge called Crime Mode (the seed is V1CE BSMT) with references to GTA like a wanted rating, guns, cops, and cars. Well, driveable minecarts.

What should have been an easy PR win for publisher Nicalis quickly turned sour as players pointed out that the music in Crime Mode sure sounds AI-generated . "It has that 'tinniness' that something like Suno generated music has", user ShweetStuff noted before looking at the music files and finding that, yep, there was Suno metadata in the file comments . Yet there was no AI disclosure on the DLC's Steam page.

Players were not thrilled by this development. Steam user reviews on The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ dropped to Overwhelmingly Negative, with only 8% positive recent reviews. Players put the blame on Nicalis, who licence Binding of Isaac from its original creator Edmund McMillen. "Edmund please take back control of the game", one said.

"Woke up to a shit show," McMillen wrote on the hatesite formerly known as Twitter when he found out what had happened, "obviously I had no idea it featured generated music in the daily run, looking into how that happened and getting it removed, stay tuned."

As of the latest update, the AI-generated music is gone. "It's a little sad given Joey Kuras (game's sound designer) did some excellent sounds for Mewgenics", ShweetStuff wrote, "but I suppose this is the industry nowadays!"

content.v: 快科技11月23日消息，iPhone Duo上市不到一个月，渠道行情已整体回落，全系渠道价跌破15999元的256GB官网原价。
据杭州数码店老板向媒体介绍，11月22日基础款渠道购买价比官网便宜1100元，与首发当天加价购买时相比行情低近4600元。
各平台与商家报价方面，拼多多256GB版本补贴价低至14699元，较官网价低1300元；得物平台256GB白色版本报价15149元，较官网价低850元。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/23/small_202611230858557504.jpg
线下数码商家全新未拆封256GB版本报价14700元，回收价约14500元，有商家称其保值率不及iPhone 18 Pro Max，部分机型转手还需再折价才能出手。
这个价格回落速度与首发阶段形成明显落差，该机正式开卖当晚，天猫苹果官方旗舰店发货时间已排至次年1月，首批货源加价普遍在4000元以上，甚至有用户加价七千多元购入。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/23/small_202611230859024739.png
10月23日512GB与1TB版本加价已回落至1500元左右，2TB版本仅加价几百元。
11月10日苹果大规模放货后，官网256GB版本转为现货，多地零售店可当天取机，官网到货时间也提前至12月18日。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/23/small_202611230859129708.png
渠道分析认为，溢价快速退潮主要源于供货较预期充足、现货铺开后稀缺感消退，加上国行机型需实名激活、二级市场流转不便，短炒囤货空间被压缩。
与此同时，部分首批用户反馈内屏开裂相关质量问题，叠加数码博主建议观望生态完善后再入手，进一步影响了潜在买家的决策。

content.v: 据Insider Gaming报道，Rockstar表示，《GTA6》的床戏场景需要经过细致设计和反复调整，以确保角色之间的身体互动能够体现杰森与露西亚的关系。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/23/cas_auto/small_0_9481492.jpg

他表示：“我们需要让玩家能够以自然、充满爱意的方式与伴侣互动，并根据玩家对这段关系的整体投入程度，让关系的发展呈现出可信的过程。为此，我们需要设计并制作相应的动画表现，在玩家自主选择与伴侣回应之间找到真实感与平衡，同时确保整个过程有趣、充满激情，并能够带来令人满足的体验。”

content.v: 据The Gamer报道，《GTA6》凭借着巨大的规模和野心，正不断征服大量游戏行业从业人员，其中就包括正在CDPR开发《赛博朋克2》的创意总监Igor Sarzynski。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/23/small_202611230834138433.jpg
我们并不清楚《GTA6》的具体开发预算，但Rockstar发行部门负责人Jennifer Kolbe近日否认了游戏耗资20亿美元的传闻，并澄清其成本低于15亿美元。对于大多数游戏开发商而言，这样的资金规模根本难以企及，毕竟绝大多数工作室都不像Rockstar那样，能够依靠《GTA Online》持续赚取巨额收入。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/23/small_202611230834395662.jpg
事实上，《赛博朋克2》创意总监Igor Sarzynski已经明确表示，CD Projekt Red并没有打算与《GTA6》竞争，尽管两款游戏系列在整体风格上存在不少相似之处。
他在Bluesky上感慨道：“《GTA6》引发的开放世界游戏开发者抑郁症是真的。说真的，我认为它可能是史上最伟大的艺术成就。无论是规模、内容密度、整体协调性，还是设计上的深思熟虑，都堪称技术与创意的奇迹。《赛博朋克2》取消了，我现在要去自家后院扫秋叶了。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/23/small_202611230834562167.jpg
“不过说正经的，我认为我们正在做属于自己的东西，拥有不同且独特的风格。《GTA》令人惊叹，就像所有伟大的艺术作品一样，它拓展了可能性的边界，并将一个令人着迷的愿景完美地呈现出来。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/23/small_202611230833486542.png
值得一提的是，游戏行业其他人士也表达了类似观点。拉瑞安工作室发行部门负责人Michael Douse（网络昵称Very AFK）表示：“并不是每款游戏都需要成为《GTA》，这既为其他类型的游戏创造了空间，也让这种难得的文化现象变得更加特别！”
顽皮狗游戏设计师Michael Barclay甚至表示，在他眼中，《GTA6》就像一辆布加迪威龙出现在一个胆怯的维多利亚时代小孩面前一样令人震撼。

items.title: 前职业劫匪亲自点评GTA6！细节有趣 但逻辑有硬伤
items.summary: 目前，无数玩家正沉浸在《GTA6》塑造的游戏世界当中，不过，Rockstar游戏中对运钞车的抢劫场景是否经得起现实检验？

content.v: 目前，无数玩家正沉浸在《GTA6》塑造的游戏世界当中，不过，Rockstar游戏中对运钞车的抢劫场景是否经得起现实检验？法国游戏媒体Jeux Video就此采访了一名曾经以抢劫为职业、如今已经改过自新的人士，而他的评价相当直接。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/23/small_202611230815597947.jpg
弗朗索瓦·特鲁肯斯（François Troukens）曾是一名职业劫匪，他对运钞车可谓再熟悉不过。他于1969年12月31日出生于比利时尼韦勒，20世纪90年代成为当地犯罪圈的知名人物，曾参与多起运钞车抢劫案。2003年，比利时司法部门缺席判处他28年监禁，当时他已经逃往南美洲。此后他返回欧洲，并于2004年在巴黎被捕，2006年的审判则促使其刑期重新审查。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/23/small_202611230816065569.jpg
他人生的转折发生在圣泰监狱服刑期间。昔日劫匪开始放下武器、拿起书本，并于2004年开始接受由巴黎索邦大学提供的现代文学课程，之后取得心理教育学相关资格，逐渐转向编剧和电影创作。
弗朗索瓦·特鲁肯斯一眼就看出了《GTA6》相关场景对电影《盗火线》的致敬。无论是镜头运镜，还是高速公路立交桥下的场景设计，游戏都明显借鉴了这部经典电影中的运钞车抢劫戏份。一些细节也得到了他的认可，例如三人组成的抢劫团队在现实中具有合理性，而使用曲棍球面具遮挡面部也是不错的选择，显然Rockstar对经典电影做足了功课。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/23/small_202611230816119845.png
但这场行动在运钞车停下来之前就已经出现了问题，因为现场没有任何车辆真正拦住运钞车。特鲁肯斯认为这种情况不合理，尤其是将摩托车放在运钞车前方根本不足以阻止它，车辆甚至可以直接碾过去。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/23/small_202611230817446313.png
运钞车的防护性能也是一大问题，其前挡风玻璃能够抵御44口径子弹，普通军用武器也难以将其击穿。虽然现实中确实存在穿甲弹，但获取难度极高，因此试图通过射击司机来迫使车辆停下的做法也不太可信。
在行动部署方面，特鲁肯斯同样对使用三辆摩托车完成如此大规模的抢劫感到疑惑。不过，整个行动最严重的失误还是出现在其中一名劫匪身上：他竟然没有佩戴头套或戴上兜帽。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/23/small_202611230817563485.jpg
曲棍球面具只能遮住面部正面，无法保护其他部位，一旦被监控拍下，很容易暴露身份。即便游戏场景制作得再精细，这种疏忽也足以让行动功亏一篑……现实中的调查人员同样不会放过这样的漏洞。

items.summary: Let the war begin.

content.v: As well as giving a spit-and-polish digital release to various Warhammer classics , antique D&D games , and the cult ellipsoid horror games in the Ecstatica series , SNEG has been bug-fixing a bunch of strategy games from years gone by and getting them up on Steam and GOG. The latest trio to appear on digital platforms are Theocracy, Soldiers at War, and Warlords 4: Heroes of Etheria.

Warlords 4 was the final turn-based game in the beloved series, with the RTS spin-off series Warlords Battlecry already two games deep by the time of its release in 2003. This updated version supports resolutions up to 4K, and incorporates community fixes and a community-made campaign. It's available on Steam and GOG .

Soldiers at War took the X-COM/UFO turn-based tactics formula—this was 1998, X-COM still had a hyphen—and applied it to World War II. You'd choose a squad of eight from your platoon of 32 each mission, fighting through a campaign that started in North Africa and ended in Germany, gaining experience along the way. SNEG's version supports 1280x720 widescreen resolution. It's available on Steam and GOG .

Theocracy narrowly beat Total War to the punch in March of 2000 with its mix of turn-based civilization management and real-time battles, tasking you with uniting Aztec tribes before the prophesied Spanish invasion. You're on the clock with 100 years to use diplomacy, trade, and warfare to bring together an empire that can stand the test of time. The updated version still has a resolution of 800x600, but uses FSR 1 to scale up for modern displays. You'll be shocked to learn, it's also available on Steam and GOG .

All three games are designed to be easy to run on modern Windows systems, and have cloud saves and achievements. I'm tempted by Warlords 4, which I didn't play at the time because I'd moved over to the real-time Battlecry games by then. But I've still got fond memories of Warlords 2 Deluxe, which had 60 different worlds so if you were tired of raising griffon armies in its generic fantasy land you could conquer something oddball like Dante's Inferno instead. Or even make your own, right down to pixel-crafting the unit art. Good times.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/22/gta-6-memorial-1795389611043.png
A GTA 6 developer has paid tribute to his late mother with an in-game memorial in Leonida that players can find and visit themselves.

Rockstar Games QA developer Matt Green shared the touching story of how his mother helped launch his career in game development and the way she was honored in the Grand Theft Auto universe with a post on Instagram. Although she passed eight months before GTA 6's launch last week, Rockstar still managed to include her in a wall of other names in a memorial located in Leonida.

"As a kid, I remember practically begging my Mum to let me get GTA: Vice City and even though she was understandably reluctant, she caved," Green said. "I think that decision is likely what set me on the path to eventually working at Rockstar Games and on GTA VI.
"She was super proud and excited to see what I'd been working on but unfortunately I never got to show her. She's been gone almost 8 months now and sometimes it still doesn't feel real."

The memorial, which Green said can be found "just north of Hamlet, shows that Bev Green passed in March 2026, and she's joined by a collection of other names, too. It's unclear if every name on the memorial is tied to another Rockstar developer's lost loved one or who the names may be referencing, but we know at least two other names are.

Production designer Terrance Radcliff took to X/Twitter to share how the team had immortalized his father and daughter, who both passed during GTA 6's development. Elhuntry Radcliff and Jade Radcliff can be seen next to each other in-game.

"To wrap up launch week, what an honor to see my Father and my first Daughter, Jade, both of who I lost during development, forever immortalized in GTA VI," Radcliff said. "To have them be a part of such a huge moment in gaming history means everything to me. Peace & blessings."

"I'm incredibly grateful that she's able to be honoured inside the world of VI," Green's post added. "Miss you Mum."

items.title: Nvidia 发布了针对其驱动程序对 SSD 造成影响的修补程序，但实际上并不起作用
items.summary: AI isn't great at fixing problems AI created.

content.v: Over the last couple of weeks, some Nvidia users noticed their SSDs were taking a hammering , reporting their driver's log file was being overwritten constantly, sometimes to the tune of 30 GB every hour. Which obviously isn't great for the lifespan of the valuable SSD you've got it installed on.

Given the problem was caused by recent driver updates, rolling back to version 621.01 was the best solution until Nvidia could do something about it. Which they did, releasing a hotfix as version 621.35 . It's not available in the GeForce app yet, but you can download it directly from Nvidia's site. Not that you should.

As users on the Nvidia subreddit are reporting, the problem persists. While the hotfix reduces the peak write rate and prevents it for a short while after reboot, it eventually creeps back in. One user reported that overnight the log file was still being rewritten by approximately 4.5 GB every hour.

So yeah, the best solution remains to roll back to version 621.01 and, as always with Nvidia drivers, to hold off on updating to the latest driver until it's been confirmed safe. If this ongoing saga sounds familiar, it's because the same thing happened to AMD's GPU drivers earlier this month. Maybe vibecoding driver updates and then vibecoding fixes for their inevitable bugs isn't the best way of doing things.

items.title: GTA 6 路的尽头：你应该奋力前行，还是选择不投降？
items.summary: A choice (or two!) can lead to drastically different endings.

content.v: Please note, this guide contains massive spoilers for some of the endings of Grand Theft Auto 6 . If you don't want to know what happens, please stop reading!

There are multiple endings to GTA 6, and not all the endings take place in the same location. One of the potential final scenes during the GTA 6 story mission , The End of the Road, takes place on a bridge in the Leonida Keys.

After discovering the cops are onto them, Jason and Lucia drive away from Cal's house and head to Brian's marina to find an airplane. The police quickly trap them on a bridge with a roadblock ahead and multiple cars behind them. Lucia wants to keep going but Jason thinks it's all over for them. The player is then given a choice, "Swim for it" or "No Surrender."
AGAIN, MASSIVE SPOILERS BELOW! STOP NOW IF YOU DON'T WANT TO KNOW THE ENDINGS !
No Surrender

Jason and Lucia decide Tomas is better off without them in his life. They drive through the roadblock, shooting at the cops. They're both shot to death and we see them dead in the front seat of the car, still holding hands. During the end credits, we see Tomas living happily with Lucia's sister and her husband and children.
Swim for it (A, B, and C)
Jason and Lucia decide to jump off the bridge and swim to freedom.

However, a second choice appears once you've chosen 'Swim for it.' As Jason gets out of the car, a prompt for Lucia to 'Exit' the car appears. You can choose for Lucia to follow through with the plan by pressing the button, or change your mind and let the prompt expire.

A: 'Swim for it' and 'Exit' : The couple will get out of the car together and walk to the edge of the bridge. Lucia jumps but Jason does not, letting himself get arrested by the cops. During the credits, Lucia signs the deal which keeps her free and sends Jason to prison. We see her bring Tomas to visit him, so Jason finally meets his son, though it's through glass.

B: 'Swim for it' and don't 'Exit' : If you choose to swim for it but don't choose the 'Exit' prompt, Jason will get out of the car but Lucia will remain in the car. The police will open fire and kill them both. As with the No Surrender option, we see Tomas living with Lucia's sister's family.

C: 'Swim for it' and 'Exit' (with $2 million in Buck Me savings) : If you delayed the Protective Custody mission of GTA 6 until you had deposited $2 million in savings, the Swim for it and Exit choices will show the same results, but during the credits, Lucia uses the money to get Jason released from prison. Lucia picks him up at prison, and Jason meets Tomas and holds his hand.
Note: These are not the only endings to GTA 6. I've seen several more endings that do not take place on the bridge at all and don't involve these particular choices.

content.v: 《杀出重围》导演沃伦·斯佩克特近日对《GTA6》的巨额开发模式提出质疑。他在祝贺开发团队的同时表示，希望该作成为这类超大型项目的最后一个案例。

content.v: 作为Xbox与PC平台独占作品，《战争机器：事变日》在美国10月游戏销量榜单上仅次于《使命召唤：现代战争4》。微软也凭借这两款作品包揽当月美国游戏销量榜前两名。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261123/1795381755_842470_jpg_r.jpg
网上有不少声音唱衰本作，甚至出现大量负面言论，但是市场数据显示《战争机器：事变日》实际市场表现相当不错。发售初期曾流传消息，称该作开发成本高达5亿美元。后续该说法被澄清：这笔金额实际是The Coalition工作室数年的整体运营总开销，其中还包含《星际争霸》重启项目等其他项目的投入，并非单这一款游戏的制作经费。
当然这不代表本作取得了压倒性的巨大成功。官方完整销售数据还未对外公布。不过市场调研机构Circana给出的统计可以证明，它在美国市场收获了很不错的成绩，拿到销量榜亚军，仅次于微软自家 IP《使命召唤》。
无论玩家对这款游戏评价如何，一款仅登陆Xbox、PC的独占游戏能拿到这样的销售成绩，本身就值得关注。很多人此前认为，不登陆PS平台会直接限制游戏的销量上限。但这份10月的统计数据表明，即便放弃 PlayStation 庞大的用户群体，微软第一方大作依然有能力在美国市场冲到榜单前列。
文章同时提到，Game Pass首发入库会影响传统买断销量统计。大量玩家通过订阅服务体验游戏，不会被计入零售/Steam买断销量，这也是网上会出现 “销量扑街” 论调的一大原因。买断销量数字偏低，不等于实际游玩人数少。
对于Xbox第一方游戏，究竟什么才算成功?是必须多平台铺货追求更高买断销量，还是守住主机PC独占，拉动自家主机硬件、订阅服务的增长？《战争机器：事变日》的表现，给行业提供了一个现实参考案例。

content.v: Xbox 360与Xbox One分别于2005年和2013年的11月22日发售，但两代主机最终留下的评价几乎处于两个极端。这组回顾将它们视为微软主机战略的高低点。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261123/1795381124_664659_jpg_r.jpg
Xbox 360凭借易用的手柄、对开发者较友好的平台环境，以及《光环：致远星》《战争机器》《极限竞速》等独占作品扩大了影响力。Xbox Live提供的好友、消息、语音派对和玩家代号等在线功能，也为此后各平台的网络服务提供了重要参照。
这款主机早期曾受“死亡红环”硬件故障困扰，由此引发召回、退款及玩家不满。此后，Xbox 360仍依靠稳定的多人游戏体验和丰富阵容积累了长期口碑。
Xbox One面对PlayStation 4时缺少足够有力的独占游戏，捆绑Kinect以及侧重影视、电视和流媒体功能又抬高了首发价格。每日联网检查、限制实体游戏借用等早期方案进一步损伤玩家信任，Kinect的实际体验也未能证明相应成本合理。
Xbox One时期暴露的第一方内容不足和信任问题，至今仍影响外界对Xbox发展方向的判断。另有内部消息称，下一代项目代号为“Project Helix”，但2027年或2028年假期档上市仅为预测，微软尚未正式公布。

content.v: 在R星尚未公布《GTA6》官方PC版的情况下，六个民间项目正尝试让其Xbox Series版本在Windows上运行。不过，目前没有任何项目展示游戏完整运行，相关工具也尚未经过独立测试。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261123/1795380747_516517_jpg_r.jpg
这些项目的开发活动据称由一批疑似泄露的Xbox版文件推动，文件容量为209GB。Leonida、Xbox2Windows和XCL分别探索静态重编译、Xbox兼容层，以及把主机着色器转换为DirectX可用代码。Leonida团队表示，已将疑似构建版本中的26503个RDNA 2着色器转换为供Vulkan使用的SPIR-V格式。
ScarlettX、AnyXboxX和基于TomBox的Xbox Emulator，则尝试解决Xbox操作系统兼容、图形指令转换和游戏代码执行等问题。ScarlettX还在开发支持Direct3D 12的兼容层。Xbox Emulator目前可以让某个旧版《堡垒之夜》进入大逃杀大厅，但仍无法游玩，也没有声音。

https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261123/1795381194_939799.webp

items.title: Rockstar Says Darts Were Cut From GTA 6 Because It Didn't Have 'Unlimited Money or Time' to Make It 'Feel Proper'
items.summary: Rockstar Games crammed a lot of content into GTA 6, but fan-favorite mini-games like darts and bowling didn't

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/20/ultimate-edition-wyman-car-collection-01-1795168394633.jpg

Rockstar Games crammed a lot of content into GTA 6 , but fan-favorite mini-games like darts and bowling didn't make the cut because the team didn't have "unlimited money or unlimited time" to do those activities justice.

Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson explained why the studio chose to focus on some aspects of development and not others during an interview with VGC . As noted by the site, picking up a game of darts has proven to be a good pastime in games like GTA 5 and GTA Online, but in GTA 6, the standards were a bit higher.

From NPCs to the feel of motorized scooters, Leonida is Rockstar's most realistic playground yet. Every blade of grass was given special attention, and while pool was one game the team was able to fully realize, not everything panned out like they had hoped. Nelson said "darts was a contentious one" when talking about the decision to cut it from the game, explaining that it was left behind because the team didn't have the resources to do it right.

"Even we… you hear they have unlimited money or unlimited time, even we do not and so sometimes you just have to admit we are not going to be able to make this to the level we feel we need to," he said.

Nelson elaborated, saying that, starting with Red Dead Redemption 2, the team started to treat mini-games more like activities. In other words, bonuses like darts became less about being a diversion of Rockstar's open worlds and more of an extension of them. The goal is to make pool, darts, or any other activity feel like it's just as punchy and weighty for Jason and Lucia as it is in the real world.
Using GTA 6's in-game workouts as an example, he added, "You’re not just pushing a button; it mimics what weightlifting is."
"A lot of work [is needed] to get it tuned right," Nelson continued. "Darts is one we just didn’t get to."

Long story short, Rockstar just "didn't have the resources" to make it "feel proper." His thoughts on the matter – or any scenario where a mechanic or activity is cut – were summed up in one line: "It’s better not to do it than to do it and have it not be good enough."
GTA 6 is now the highest-rated game of all time . IGN gave it a 10/10 review .

For one of the better examples of the care the developers put into side activities, look no further than some of the games Jason has on his JoySystem . You can see how Rockstar pulled from real-world inspirations to create his character here .

items.title: Unreal Engine 6 to jettison key scripting feature earlier than planned in favor of AI coding
items.summary: Bye-bye, Blueprints.

content.v: Unreal Engine 6 will not launch with the engine's long-standard Blueprints scripting system. The news came in a Friday, November 19 post on the Unreal Engine website , written by Epic Games executive vice president of development, Marcus Wassmer. Here's Wassmer's top-level summary from the post:

Blueprints have not (and it appears, will not) be deprecated in Unreal Engine 5, and the company maintains that projects will still be easy to convert from UE5 to UE6. Wassmer cited a declining cost in AI task completion as one reason for this belief, as well as the team's ongoing, but apparently successful conversion of Fortnite's Blueprint library to UE6's Verse programming language through an AI-assisted process.

Blueprints are a widely-used feature of Unreal. Former Valve developer Chet Faliszek, an AI skeptic, has put out a vlog on the subject . Essentially, Faliszek argues that Blueprints (and features like them in other game engines) represent a middle ground between artistic and technical work, an introduction and skill builder for less technically-minded developers. Without them, such developers seemingly have to either learn Verse code, or integrate LLM prompting into their workflows.

"We made a new skill in the middle there, between normal and expert," Faliszek said of intermediate tools like Blueprints. "To lose that determinism from game design, and instead have to prompt AI⁠—or write your own Verse … It's losing those tools that made all those designers and all those artists so powerful, to be able to do really powerful things and have access to really deep-down things, but in a safe way that the engineers can decide what that meant to them."

A dark horse game of the year candidate, the first-person RPG Queen's Domain , was made with Unreal Engine. I recently spoke to co-developer Eric Berger, who specialized in art and design alongside the more technically-focused Bradley Boothe, a relationship that rhymes with the ones Faliszek outlined in his video.

I spoke to Berger before seeing Epic's latest press release, but Berger already indicated that Unreal's AI pivot is prompting Freshly Baked Games to switch engines for its next project. I followed up with Berger about this Blueprint news, and the developer said that Blueprints were a major part of the workflow on Queen's Domain.

I'm a layman in game development, but I think Wassmer's post elides that there is a large qualitative difference between doing any work via LLM prompt versus the old-fashioned way⁠—I don't like or want to use these tools, myself, and I don't think that's an unpopular stance. Commenter ZILtoid1991 on Faliszek's video compared the move to Apple removing headphone jacks on the iPhone, a comparison I find fruitful.

It was hugely unpopular at the time, and is still derided by enthusiasts, but it also worked . Other manufacturers copied Apple, and everybody has bluetooth headphones now⁠—or Apple's own, proprietary Air Pods. But Apple had far less success trying something similar with its laptops: The lack of ports on late 2010s Macbooks proved disastrous, and Apple has since reintroduced more (and a wider variety of) ports on newer models of the popular line. I certainly have my own anti-AI, pro-headphone jack preferences, but we'll have to see how this plays out with the Unreal Engine.

items.title: GTA 6 需要一个专门的团队来确保所有不同的体型都可以共享动画：“这是团队的巨大努力”
items.summary: Making sure your animations don't break while you're cultivating mass.

content.v: We don't know precisely how big GTA 6's "big boy" budget was, but let's put aside the alarming excess of contemporary mass-consumption entertainment for a moment and talk about the real big boy: bulked up Jason.

While GTA 6's body morphing might not go quite as far (in terms of waistband measurements) as its predecessor San Andreas—or even a game like Fable 2—it does boast extensive variety of different body shapes among its cast, and making that work at such a high level of visual fidelity took an entire dedicated team.

In an interview with IGN , Rockstar vice president of animation Mark Tennant said it was an early decision in development to "push the variation in character sizes and body types … This required us to establish a very robust way to share animations between characters while still resolving multiple points of contact, such as most vehicle interactions and grappling in hand-to-hand combat."

It also took eschewing a "traditional approach" in favor of "new techniques," the sort I imagine you can only implement at Rockstar levels of budget and manpower. "We also had to grow a team dedicated to overseeing the implementation, which required close collaboration with the art and rigging teams," said Tennant. "All these aspects needed to come together to make it work, so it was a huge team effort."

In the same IGN piece, senior technical art director Valmor Garcia said the ultimate goal was to ensure each character had "singular awareness and visual identities," which included giving them unique faces and anatomy (the six-figure animation count is part of that too, I imagine). All the blood, sweat, and so on seem to be paying off given the game's absolutely massive launch , but Saints Row 3 is still the only crime sandbox that lets me replace all my character's dialog with meaningless zombie grunts , so it's impossible to say which is better.

items.title: 新的 Dota 2 补丁试图帮助游戏更快结束，添加了一个可以在每条车道上同时召唤超级小兵的物品
items.summary: It's awfully reminiscent of ideas you can find in other, more fast-paced MOBAs.

content.v: The longest game of Dota I've played was comfortably past the 70-minute mark. Matches that gloriously long-winded can be fun in small doses, but they can also be exhausting and infuriating—this is Dota we're talking about, after all. The latest patch to rearrange the venerable MOBA, 7.42, is finally here , and it's got tons of changes that might just prevent your games from going feature length.

The most exciting of these, for my money, is the Greater Horn of Battle: a guaranteed drop from the Tormentor neutral monster that summons a wave of super creeps in all your team's lanes (the patch notes refer to them as the more powerful mega creeps, but players have noted the stats don't match up that way). If you've played League of Legends or Deadlock, it fills a niche similar to the Rift Herald or Deadlock's Unstable Rifts—an objective you can complete in the earlier stages of a game to push lane(s) hard.

It's an ability that, if timed correctly, could force the other team to scramble to protect each lane or risk losing lots of ground. And it's not the only change with the potential to speed up matches.

Base hero health has gone up from 120 to 200, with the caveat that strength now gives less health per point, meaning that heroes will be sturdier early on but slightly squishier later. The Glyph of Fortification, a teamwide spell that makes buildings invulnerable, no longer resets its cooldown when certain buildings go down. Heroes also now gain experience passively, even when dead, meaning that you never completely stop growing stronger as the match progresses.

It will probably take some time to see if this actually meaningfully reduces match times or if these changes even stick around for long, but personally, anything that makes Dota a little bit speedier has the potential to reignite my passion for the game. Whenever I dip in these days, it's to play the fastest mode possible—Turbo, which accelerates every aspect of play and gives you oodles of gold just for existing—but it's so different from the traditional Dota setup that it may as well be a new game.

items.title: GTA 6 话语正遭受地平效应影响
items.summary: Didn't you hear? You can't even steal cars anymore.

content.v: If you ever watch science videos on social media, you've probably been served a video of someone debunking the claims of a flat earther.

It starts with a clip of some belligerent dope demanding to know why, if the earth is so round, ships don't disappear over the horizon. A greenscreened science communicator then appears, rubs their forehead, and shows us a video of a ship disappearing over the horizon. Checkmate.

It's good content, but if you linger too long on one of those videos, you'll get another, and then another, and pretty soon your whole feed will be debunking videos. Now you're enrolled in a never ending lesson plan which features such insights as 'an all-meat diet is not good for you,' 'the moon landing was real,' and 'hating women is not in fact based .'

The total effect of this is that the most ignorant and dishonest quacks and provocateurs get to set the level of discourse, and instead of investigating new metaphorical horizons in topics that interest you, you wind up watching people debate the existence of the actual horizon.

Which brings me to Grand Theft Auto 6. Despite making $3.79 billion on its launch day, it's easy to stumble across confident social media claims that it's a total flop and everyone's going to refund it. According to popular X posts, GTA 6 doesn't even let you steal cars anymore, and there are hundreds of Metacritic user reviewers insisting that it's far-left propaganda rather than the mass-market entertainment product it obviously is.

It's the videogame discourse version of flat eartherism. The millions of people playing GTA 6 do not think it is a "cuck simulator" because you can buy a woman flowers, but it's hard not to react to the few dorks making that claim, even though focusing on debunking them severely limits the depth of the conversations we can then have about the game. Good luck discussing your feelings if you dislike GTA 6 for normal reasons!

Over the past few days, I've entertained sparks of hope that GTA 6 could be the flashpoint that brings us out of this era of videogame discourse. The millions of people playing it and not reacting like buffoons are surely irrefutable evidence that culture war dunces don't represent the masses.
But then again, we're still pointing at videos of ships going over the horizon to prove that the earth isn't flat.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/22/jason-duval-gta-6-1795371162747.png
Rockstar Games has opened up about GTA 6 protagonist Jason's viral personality and the two specific inspirations that helped bring him to life.

As 13 years of waiting for the next Grand Theft Auto ended last week, players have found themselves enamored with Jason Duval. Stoic, nonchalant, calm, composed, resigned; whatever you want to call one of GTA 6's new protagonists, Rockstar says it carefully crafted his already iconic demeanor by pulling from a Steve McQueen classic and real-life veterans.

The studio's senior vice president of narrative, Rupert Humphries, talked about how the studio behind the mega-hit video game built Jason from the ground up during a conversation with Destructoid . Centering the story on a "couple on the run" marked new territory for Rockstar, but it's far from a new concept in entertainment. So, the team turned to movies, particularly Sam Peckinpah's The Getaway.

"Steve McQueen was famous for pulling lines out of scripts and saying things with his presence alone," Humphries explained. "We wanted to see how close we could get to that with a game character, where so many of our protagonists have been the opposite."

He continued, saying that Rockstar's research into real-world veterans and Army Rangers helped refine its approach. Those who have played the game (and keen-eyed trailer watchers ) already know about Jason's military background, so the influence here definitely tracks.
"These guys typically aren’t running their mouths or reacting to something unless it’s strictly necessary, while still being strong and still asserting themselves."

Jason is the talk of Vice City and has been for some time. As Rockstar shared more details about its seemingly shy lead ahead of GTA 6's launch, some fans began to wonder if he could be the franchise's first-ever neurodivergent protagonist . In addition to his personality, Humphries described Jason as "wired differently" during a recent interview with Love magazine.

While Jason steals more than just wads of cash in Vice City, his partner in crime has proven to be just as impactful. Game writer Michael Wiafe said looking into the kind of criminal activity known to make headlines in Florida was one of the first things the team did when creating both Jason and Lucia. For Rockstar, it wasn't just about creating true-to-life criminals; it was about creating fully realized human beings.

"From then on, it was about coming up with authentic characters that didn’t stray too far from reality but also were not totally bound by it either," Wiafe said. "The majority of our main characters are undeniably reprehensible on paper, full-blown criminals, but also decent human beings. Their moral makeup isn’t necessarily cut-and-dry, and we don’t attempt to make excuses for them. What’s important is how they resonate, no matter where you’re experiencing the game in the world."

Between the chaos of robbing gas stations and drug dealers and getting into high-speed car chases, Jason and Lucia can become quite the power couple. Game writer Elizabeth Gauvey-Kern said to Destructoid, "You really want them to make it." The quiet moments where the duo scrolls through social media in their bed or drives the other one to work can be just as important as the action set pieces. Gauvey-Kern added, "Those need to hit too, and you need to connect with how the characters are feeling in those moments."

Although GTA 6 launched for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S three days ago, Leonida is packed with enough things to do to keep players playing for months. While we wait to see what's next for Rockstar, you can check out IGN's 10/10 review . You can also read about how the developers made every NPC feel like real people you could run into on the street .

content.v: Grand Theft Auto 6 has been out in the hands of console players for a few days now, and a few of us at PC Gamer have been dusting off our PlayStations and Xboxes to dive into Leonida as we eagerly anticipate its eventual (but yet unannounced) PC release next year potentially.

I've been gaming it up myself and, as is always the case with GTA, I am absolutely loving driving around. Flying down the highway, exploring all the alleyways and retail areas, and taking out to the waters on a boat or jetski. All of it, of course, to the soundtrack of GTA 6's various radio stations.

There are a huge number of stations in this game—19 of them, to be exact—with a ton of excellently-curated songs lingering within and famous cameo hosts. Usually I find myself just picking one station and sticking to it, but with GTA 6? I've been cycling between quite a few, each one offering something a little bit different.

Four stations have been grabbing most of my attention though. Pop station Flash FM has easily gained the most airtime in my playthrough so far. Am I listening to Ariana Grande in my everyday life? No. But am I bombing it down the highway while singing Break Free to myself every time it comes on? I absolutely am.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/zvDuuxmLCYLeFkh6tej3HD-1920-80.jpg

But I've also been peppering in a ton of 80s station Vice City FM. I mean, c'mon, you've got Weird Al Yankovic as a co-host, first of all. But you've also got straight up bangers like Lionel Richie's All Night Long, Simply Red's Money's Too Tight (To Mention), and Billy Ocean's Loverboy.

There's also Emotion 98.3, the radio station dedicated to songs about love (both being in love and being heartbroken, of course) and yes, I have stayed in the car waiting to hear Phil Collins' excellent drumming in In The Air Tonight. And finally, because I am a raging emo at heart, I've obviously had to whack on a bunch of The Chamber 106.6. Tool, System of a Down, and Metallica? Count me in.

But what about you? If any of you PC gamers are partaking on console, is only one radio station catching your attention, or have you found yourself channel hopping just like me? Or is there somehow not a single station that's caught your fancy, instead finding the podcasts a more entertaining use of your listening time? Be sure to drop a comment and let me know.

items.summary: And not just for GTA 6 Online, right? Right?

content.v: I'd just stolen my very first airplane in GTA 6 and was happily cruising over the city when I looked out my window and saw an enormous purple building. I banked, slowed down, and flew a bit closer to read the huge sign on the roof.
VICE CITY CASINO

Oh, hell yes. I was so excited to throw my carefully accumulated three hundred dollars away on poker and slots that I immediately attempted my very first landing. After the explosion and my miraculous resurrection, I rushed back to the casino and crashed again, this time with my body into the locked front doors.
The casino in GTA 6 is closed. Trust me, I tried every door, and the only one that opened was a utility closet.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/yaWKm5uBDKKnkPF4fqwBME-1920-80.jpg

I was early into my playthrough, still in Chapter 1 of the GTA 6 story missions , so I thought maybe there'll be some mission that unlocks the casino so I can play some poker, try my luck at the slots, and maybe bet on the also-closed dog track—I assume it's a dog track because I've seen dogs in GTA 6, but no horses—that's right next door to the casino.

Nope! I'm now 100% done with the main story and that casino is still closed. And that's not the only business in GTA 6 that isn't open for business. Not even a half-mile away from the casino there's a go-cart track called Hot Skidz sporting a huge "Coming Soon" sign. I saw that early in my game as well, and checked back later. Still closed. I also found a second, smaller casino. Also closed.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/kz3ujKSYmxByibLEwspQTE-1920-80.jpg

What a letdown. I managed to get my motorcycle onto the go-cart track, and as I drove glumly around it, alone, having no fun, I perked up a bit. Maybe this just gives me something to look forward to. A hint of more singleplayer content that'll be coming to GTA 6 next year. Hopefully next year.
There's already a lot of seemingly unfinished stuff in GTA 6, partial systems that could be added to and completed, like:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Tigjf2DgCfTNSmF7esPhKE-1920-80.jpg

I felt better after that, but as I went back to stare at that huge, closed casino—which is all lit up at night like it's actually open, even though it is not open, and I know this because I rechecked all the doors—I remembered how the casino in GTA 5 worked. It came to the game post launch, but only as part of GTA Online. It never opened in singleplayer.

But surely, why include the building at all in GTA 6 singleplayer if it wasn't also going to be in singleplayer? They wouldn't do that to us, would they? They wouldn't open it in GTA 6 Online and not open it in GTA 6 singleplayer.
That would be like putting dozens of dogs in a game and not letting us have our own dog. Madness.

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/f5gqaz7eCsM2ureqJVRebT-1920-80.jpg

The Declasse Vamos is one of the many cars Moses asks you to steal for him in GTA 6 , but like the BF Bandito , it's a little trickier than just grabbing it. When you reach the map marker, you'll realise the car is locked in a garage that requires a specific code to open it.

The code to the door is 2727 and this is fixed. The way you discover this is by sneaking inside the trailer and looking at the number plate on the wall to the left of the window, just above the guy snoozing in the chair.

Enter the code to open the garage, break in with the slimjim, then hit the button to open the door. I personally incapacitated all of the people behind the trailer, so chances are they will pursue you or start shooting if you don't, once you try to drive out of there.
Now take the car back to Moses, being careful on the way, to earn $4,100ish for top condition.

items.title: 《洛克·拉莫拉的谎言》一书的作者斯科特·林奇在《星球大战：叛乱》中的时长为 1,493 小时，在《BattleTech: 'If J.R.R.》中的时长为 1,564 小时。托尔金有一个 Steam 帐户，他的数字也会很尴尬”
items.summary: The fantasy novelist guides us through the games on his PC.

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/DEwkbfkEmfdtjT5P9ybme-1920-80.png

Welcome to Disk Cleanup , our regular weekend feature delving into the PCs of PC gaming luminaries. Come back every weekend to read a new interview, digging into the important questions, like "How tidy is your desktop?" and "What game will you never uninstall?"

Playing on school computers has been a rite of passage for many young PC gamers, whether through dedicated edutainment titles or rogue installations by chancing pupils. But fantasy novelist Scott Lynch went one step further: he took the school computers home.

"My mother worked for our school district, so I'd occasionally have the chance to sneak into the computer lab, or we would borrow and Apple II over the summer," Lynch says. "When we did that, I borrowed Infocom games … text-only adventure games from the '80s like Zork, Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, Planetfall, A Mind Forever voyaging. I was really into those when I was about 12."

Text-based adventures would eventually become a defining feature of Lynch's life, albeit in a different format. His debut novel, The Lies of Locke Lamora , was published in 2006, charting the schemes and adventures of a group of master con artists called The Gentleman Bastards. Two further novels in The Gentleman Bastard Sequence have since followed: 2007's Red Seas Under Red Skies , and 2013's The Republic of Thieves

Lynch currently working on a novella in the same world called More Than Fools Fill Graves, as well as his highly anticipated fourth novel, The Thorn of Emberlain. "It is something that I am absolutely working on and trying to be as open and honest about as possible," he says. But he took a quick break from writing elaborate fantasy heists to show me around the treasure-filled vault of his Steam library.
What game are you currently playing?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/JmF4o6RuMPxHWWr64cRf5N-1920-80.jpg

I have reopened Morrowind for the first time in a number of years. Right around the time I was working on my first novel and had not finished it yet, I was playing it on the original Xbox. Other than the fact I was like 23, 24, I can't fathom how I did that.

I've been meaning to go back to Morrowind for ages, but I was put off by the jankiness of the UI, the quality-of-life experience, or the thought that there were just enough rough edges of this game that's now nearly a quarter of a century old, that I wouldn't enjoy it.

I was talking to another author who maybe has a bad computer game habit, and he turned me on to OpenMW. He posted some screenshots on Bluesky of some beautiful-looking Morrowind vistas and some nice skies and vegetation. And I thought "A-ha! Here's a man that uses mods." So even though I own a copy of Morrowind, like the fourth copy I've bought in my life, I'm now using OpenMW, and I'm loving it.

The thing that I enjoy about Morrowind is the incredible granularity of its various subsystems and the game-breaking things that you can do with processes like alchemy and enchantment. And the fact you can enchant layers of clothing and be wearing enchanted underwear underneath your enchanted armour. [But] I set a bunch of rules for my character, because usually I play something along the lines of a wizard who can go anywhere, do anything, build high-powered potions to fly all over the landscape at high speed.

I decided that I would play something along the template of a Paladin, and I gave myself a very limited powerset that I could create utilising the custom spell-builders … so I have a very limited toolset, and I opted to spend more time actually wandering around the world doing quests, and less time sitting in one place making 10,000 potions.

I played Skyrim to death [with] many character concepts, and one of my favourites was a little ruleset that I called the Conan playthrough, where you play as melee-type character who cannot use magic at all … you place all these rules and limitations upon yourself. What I found is that narrowing the focus of the game experience can be as liberating as having a completely open world before you, and I've rediscovered that with this particular Morrowind playthrough.
What was the previous game you played, and is it still installed?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4HGkPb3PmYS897a6BtnUbm-1920-80.jpg

It's a game from the late '90s called Star Wars: Rebellion, which over in the UK would have been known as Star Wars: Supremacy. It's elderly, it's janky, its UI and its quality of life are from a previous era of human development. It's absolutely full of problems. But it's also got kernels of brilliance, and there's never been anything like it ever since. As a Star Wars fan, I find myself returning to it over and over, as a dog to his vomit.
What is the oldest game (by release date) currently installed on your PC?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/zmZcheyxxT64dL5Jqsh4tV-1920-80.jpg

I've still got Master of Orion 2 , and it's still playable, which is from '90s. I love MOO2. I've played it to death in every possible permutation. I last played Master of Orion about five years ago. That would have also been in the pandemic.

You can see how nearly every game in the 4X space has been trying for the last three decades to, in some fashion, be that game and recreate its experience, and that's a very difficult thing to do … MOO2 just has a certain smoothness to it.

I've tried to get into other 4X games … but I just don't think that any 4X space game since MOO2 has successfully emulated that smoothness of pickup and that open sense of play, as in "Where's my civilization going to go?"

To a certain extent when you play a game like MOO2, outside the bounds of creating a custom species and a custom culture, you're playing with somebody else's IP, and when I play a game like that, I look for a certain degree of possessiveness, a certain degree of personalisation. I want to play my species' story and I don't necessarily want to play with somebody else's narrative IP.
What is the highest number of hours you have in any given game, according to Steam?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/kJoUUt9XGp5syJGRME4oyH-1920-80.jpg
All right, let's look at the embarrassing total. All I'm going to say about this is that if J.R.R Tolkien had had a Steam account, his numbers would be pretty embarrassing too.

I've got a couple of suspects. Star Wars: Rebellion, keeping in mind, this is since 2012, because that's when I noticed that it was on Steam and I went 'Oh, cool.' At 1,493 hours. That'll be hard to top. Fallout: New Vegas, only 630 hours, but that's also a bit of a lie because I had that game on two different Xbox 360s.
But the winner is definitely BattleTech . I've got a truly embarrassing 1,564 hours. I spent a lot of time commanding a BattleTech company during the pandemic.

I have played this so much. I have experienced every bark, every random event, every edge and corner, I have played it to a point beyond which it was designed to be played … After you've played a game for 1,500 hours, you see problems that would not be visible to a normal human being.
I have experienced every bark, every random event, every edge and corner.
Scott Lynch

It is janky. It is imperfect. It is a notorious memory leak rat bastard that can hang and slow down forever. But it is a marvellous, diverting game that does exactly what it promised, designed by people who really love the setting and really love the playstyle, with just marvellous production design. It really returns that feel of being 12 or 13, poring over old BattleTech manuals and wishing I had somebody to play the game with who was as obsessive as me.

items.title: 前Rockstar环境艺术家打破沉默：GTA 6“总体上令人惊叹”，但Red Dead 2可能有更好的河流
items.summary: "I want to celebrate this world that I spent literal years working on."

content.v: David O'Reilly, an environment artist who worked at Rockstar for 12 years on games like Red Dead Redemption 2, Grand Theft Auto 5, and the just-released GTA 6, recently started a YouTube channel called Game World Art where he explores videogame environments. For the last year and a half or so, he's chatted about those games and others from his point of view, sharing tidbits about the tech involved in making them—and now that GTA 6 is out, he's showing off his work and offering some impressions.

"To set expectations, this is not a Rockstar insider-type channel, it's not telling you exactly how Rockstar makes their worlds, this is more about seeing these kinds of open world games—and this one in particular—through my eyes and my perspective as an environment artist," he said in the video.

In his impressions video, he cruises around for a while and talks about his changing relationship to Rockstar games. Given that putting them together was literally his day job, he couldn't enjoy games like RDR 2 and GTA 5 "to anywhere near the extent" that can enjoy GTA 6—since he left the studio in 2023, he's got some distance from the final game. That doesn't mean he's turning the analytical part of his brain off entirely, though, as he stopped here and there to critique the world he saw.

He called the game's art "generally stunning" and "almost flawless," saying it was visually better than Crimson Desert, which was hamstrung by a "slight jankiness." But he also said he preferred RDR 2's rivers, which he worked on extensively to the point that it became a specialty. If you think he's being persnickety, he did note that he's "obsessed with rivers," and has argued in a previous video that Crimson Desert's rivers "just clinch it" over Red Dead's. Hopefully we can get a definitive river tier list from O'Reilly soon to settle matters on a broader scale.

Still, he had almost exclusively positive things to say, and was careful to note that it's hard for any one artist to take credit for anything on a game as huge in scope as a Rockstar open world heist-'em-up. Ultimately, it seems like he's mostly pleased to see his and his friends' work finally out in the open: "I want to celebrate this world that I spent literal years working on. And I have plenty of friends who are still at Rockstar who have worked on this for a long time, and I couldn't be more pleased for you all."

items.title: 这款 90 年代风格的恐怖游戏拥有我见过的最酷的后世界末日世界之一
items.summary: Plus you can experience it all from the comfort of your campervan.

content.v: I often find myself thinking where the best place to survive a zombie apocalypse would be. A walled-off stone house would certainly make for some good defenses, a boat would be great—but only if the zombies didn't pull a Fear the Walking Dead—or you could spend the end of the world in a camper van. That would certainly be whimsical.

You do just this in The Road of Dust and Sorrow's demo , although it's certainly not as whimsical as I first imagined it to be. You see, in this 2D horror game you have bigger responsibilities than just keeping yourself alive, you also have a young daughter to look out for as well.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/3qj4tCVwdCkQLD7cj9zESc-1920-80.jpg

This isn't an easy task. Supplies are dwindling, zombie-like humans infected by addictive chemicals amble across the land in search of more dust, but they'll settle for your blood instead. Plus there's this creepy Pastor who's definitely up to something very bad. I only got one glimpse of him in the demo and he was surrounded by a lot of gore and eldritch horror, so I've just decided that staying away from him is probably for the best.

But you can't hunker down and forget about all these terrors, because you have a daughter to feed and protect. So I spent most of my time in the demo gathering food, medical supplies, and trying to locate an item that may just grant us safe passage to the only sanctuary humanity has left.

The dev, Painted Black Games, says it took inspiration from horror series like Silent Hill and Resident Evil for The Road of Dust and Sorrow, and while I haven't come across anything particularly traumatic in a Silent Hill sense yet (although I wouldn't be surprised to see that here) I can see the through line to Resident Evil.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/GtyQoXssDh4pZCnrRUDSWc-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/nfKucX4PAWSV2juT3ten9c-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/xK2EisGpLEFVJrkjuNEn5c-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Ri4rebp7CzRGzpJKwLbgwb-1920-80.jpg

The action is smooth, accurate, and rewarding—which surprised me as I usually don't vibe with 2D gunplay, sometimes the controls are too finicky, but it certainly works here. Head-shotting the zombies is incredibly satisfying, as is kicking them to the floor and beating them with a baseball bat.

Then there are the puzzles. I didn't come across too many, but the ones I did find were very rewarding. It's not rocket science, but the solutions aren't always obvious either. They are, however, very intuitive; you can do a lot with a little, something I very much appreciate.

But my favourite aspect of The Road of Dust and Sorrow has to be just how cool this post-apocalyptic world is. Maybe it's the pixel art, but it manages to look dilapidated and creepy while also being oddly pretty to look at. I was searching an abandoned warehouse full of zombies and rotting cargo while thinking to myself that with a bit of elbow grease this place could really scrub up.

If you want pretty and cosy, though, the campervan is where it's at. I didn't spend as much time as I would have liked to there, but it managed to feel like a real home—the only safe place left in this world.
